messages:
olivia: Heads-up — I opened a quick follow-up on console instrumentation ownership. We're seeing gaps in latency attribution for dashboard queries when requests proxy through the new query-gateway.

devon: Can you paste a trace? Where is the missing span?

olivia: sample trace — trace id 0x9a3, shows gateway span then a long gap and direct console span. Looks like gateway isn't propagating the internal route tag we use to split tenant vs system requests.

anita: That's because the gateway strips internal headers in the edge handler for security. We added that to fix leaking auth tokens.

sam: That's intentional but we need a mapping. Two options: 1) gateway adds a safe route_id header (sanitized) so downstream can attribute; 2) runtime emits attribution by looking at token-scoped claims.

leah: Option 1 seems simpler and low-risk. Edge just emits X-RW-Route: <route>. No PII. Then tracing uses that.

devon: Tradeoffs: adds coupling between gateway and console metric model. We'll need a clear versioned contract and unit tests on both sides.

olivia: Also SLO impact — current dashboard SLOs are per-route. Without proper attribution we undercount some tenants. If we go option 1, we need a migration: run both attribution models and compare for a week.

anita: Ops concern: RBAC. If we add route header, ensure it can't be forged by external clients. Gateway must canonicalize and overwrite any incoming header.

sam: Agreed. Gateway should set header server-side and drop incoming X-RW-Route. Also add a short TTL into trace metadata so stale proxies don't replay.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: gateway-edge v2.14 with header-canonicalization (deploy id 2324). ETA 10m :rocket:

leah: Action items: Olivia to PR spec for X-RW-Route; Devon to add unit tests for tracing in console; Anita to confirm header canonicalization in gateway; Sam to schedule a one-week double-run and compare metrics. I'll own the postmortem if numbers diverge.

olivia: I'll draft the PR and include the SLO comparison query. Will ping here when ready. :thumbsup:
